name: Follow the line
title: How's your heart today?
note: Follow the line carousel posted; all verses checked
caption:
Follow your line, then tell us where it landed.

Whether your heart feels heavy, anxious, restless or grateful this morning, you can bring all of it to God. He hears you and holds you through every bit of today.

Psalm 107:1, Philippians 4:6, Psalm 55:22, Psalm 62:1 (BSB)
